scope: Bind the named missing_construction_material_metadata automatic FAIL to machine-validated construction/material metadata at both formal-render preparation and final Visual Fidelity scoring.

finding.problem: The formal scene metadata validator proved active-renderer domain coverage, while the detailed material/construction registry had a separate validator. The Visual Fidelity scoring path required a human critical-defect review but did not itself machine-revalidate the metadata state. A reviewer could therefore mark missing_construction_material_metadata absent without the final scoring path proving the registry and current scene coverage together.
finding.risk: A nominal >=92 score could become eligible while a named automatic-fail condition was not independently bound to the exact scoring path.
finding.priorityReason: This closes a hard-gate correctness hole before speculative visual expansion. It does not claim or award render quality.

changes.summary: Scene metadata validation now also requires the detailed construction/material registry, validates an explicit critical-defect binding contract, and source-audits that formal render and scoring entry points retain fail-closed metadata checks.

Reviewed evidence validation now machine-revalidates the current benchmark scene metadata and material/construction registry before repetition/light-leak/temporal diagnostics and before the numeric Visual Fidelity gate can proceed.

Schema 1.1.0 adds criticalDefectBinding for missing_construction_material_metadata, requiring registry validation, active-renderer coverage, fail-closed formal-render/scoring integration, zero source-awarded visual points, and no source-side clearance of rendered defects.

verification.reasonRuntimePending: No Unity runner/workflow/status context is available on this branch yet.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.gateImpact: Prevents the metadata automatic-fail from being bypassed by a human absent-mark alone.

nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 runtime/runner is still required to compile the updated editor QA, execute the formal metadata bindings against the generated benchmark scene, produce native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing evidence plus 100% crops and sealed temporal probes, and score only the resulting pixels.
